| PHYSICAL COMBAT ~~
. Physical attack.

Raise your anger 1 level. You may discard a card from
your hand. If you discarded a Styled card, this attack
stays in play to be used a second time this combat.
DAMAGE: AT +3 stages.

(Banish after use.)
